rail.validityNote: Catalogue dates and verified bytes do not establish September 2026 alignment validity. Inferred infrastructure paths, not certified service running tracks.
rail.transformation: Existing XTF parser; LV95 simplification 5 m and swisstopo approximate LV95-to-WGS84 transformation rounded to 6 decimals.
rail.policy: Exact national rail route and operating-point identities; full ordered stop chains constrain infrastructure paths. Catalogue dated 2021-07-06, present alignment validity unknown. No actual running-track certification.

roads.modifications: Gleislicht: pfaedle matching of complete GTFS patterns, warning rejection, bounded connectors, monotone shape-distance slicing and 5 m simplification. OSM inference, not an operator alignment or diversion certificate.

officialLocalInvestigation.reuse: Official terms permit use, modification, redistribution and commercial use of access-A cantonal geodata with source attribution. B/C layers have specific restrictions. WFS service access statement requests formal contact. Availability and a dataset-specific export are unresolved; this is not a claim that all cantonal data lack reuse rights.

excludedSources.reason: Legal catalogue discovery record; distribution and vintage unestablished.
Cantonal road axes, not public-transport line paths.
Public transport stop/accessibility layers, not route geometry.
SwissTLM topographic rail/cable infrastructure, not dated bus lines; existing hash-verified FOT used for rail.
Cable installations inventory includes infrastructure beyond scheduled passenger services; no timetable identity crosswalk reviewed.
